description: Labelled questions for retrieval evaluation. Each question lists substrings that a correct passage must contain. Substring matching is a proxy for human relevance labels: cheap, deterministic, and good enough to compare configurations against each other. Replace these with questions over your own corpus.

questions.question: What is invoice number INV-2024-0871 for?
questions.rationale: Exact identifier. Pure vector search typically misses these; the keyword leg exists for this case.

questions.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
questions.rationale: Wording differs from the document. Keyword search alone fails; the vector leg carries this one.

questions.question: What does the SLA guarantee for uptime?
questions.rationale: Acronyms embed poorly but match lexically.

questions.question: Compare the Q1 and Q2 revenue figures
questions.rationale: Needs two distinct passages. Tests whether MMR keeps the result set diverse instead of returning five copies of the Q1 paragraph.

questions.question: What is the airspeed velocity of an unladen swallow?
questions.rationale: Nothing should clear the relevance floor. A system that always returns its top-k will hallucinate here.
